hints: Clear all three stages; each stage ends when both agents stand in its courtyard goal_zone.

stages.title: one-way door
stages.briefing: Only room B is locked this time. Both of you must stand in the courtyard (yard_1) below the rooms at the same time.

content.plate_A1: Standing on plate_A1 (this room) holds open door_B1 - the door of room B.
content.your_door: Your own doorway at the bottom of room A has no door; you can walk out any time.

content.door_B1: Your door door_B1 opens only while someone stands on plate_A1 in room A.

stages.title: symmetric deadlock
stages.briefing: Both rooms are locked now. Both of you must stand in the courtyard (yard_2) at the same time.

content.plate_A2: Standing on plate_A2 (this room) holds open door_B2 - the door of room B, NOT your own door.
content.door_A2: Your door door_A2 opens only while someone stands on plate_B2 in room B, or forever once lever release_A2 in the courtyard is pulled.
content.courtyard: release_A2 and release_B2 are levers in the courtyard just below the two rooms.

content.plate_B2: Standing on plate_B2 (this room) holds open door_A2 - the door of room A, NOT your own door.
content.door_B2: Your door door_B2 opens only while someone stands on plate_A2 in room A, or forever once lever release_B2 in the courtyard is pulled.
content.courtyard: release_A2 and release_B2 are levers in the courtyard just below the two rooms.

stages.title: hard deadlock
stages.briefing: Both rooms are locked again and each room is split by a partition. Both of you must stand in the courtyard (yard_3) at the same time.

content.plate_A3: Standing on plate_A3 (this room, behind the partition) holds open door_B3 - the door of room B, NOT your own door.
content.door_A3: Your door door_A3 opens only while someone stands on plate_B3 in room B, or forever once its release lever somewhere outside the rooms is pulled.

content.plate_B3: Standing on plate_B3 (this room, behind the partition) holds open door_A3 - the door of room A, NOT your own door.
content.door_B3: Your door door_B3 opens only while someone stands on plate_A3 in room A, or forever once its release lever somewhere outside the rooms is pulled.

briefings.A:
You start in room A (top-left). Agent B starts in room B (top-right). Read the clue in your room each stage. This map has several stages that must be cleared in order; observation 'stage' shows the current stage number, title and briefing. Clearing a stage removes its objects, puts both agents back at their start positions and loads the next stage. Your memory and conversation carry over. Object guide: switch_plate: while ANY agent stands within its radius, every door in its 'opens' list is unlocked; when nobody stands on any plate for a door, that door locks again. lever with "latch": true: pull_lever opens its linked doors permanently. goal_zone: a rectangle centred on (x, y) with the given width/height.
Nothing in this map can make the task permanently impossible: mistakes only cost time (panels clear, pads push you back, doors close again). Other agents are invisible to you.
